# SITE ARCHITECTURE: 916 Dent & Detail

Sized to the business: a two-technician mobile operation (plus crew) with six owner-named services, a retail and a B2B door, no storefront, no prices, no reviews, no job photos, and thin sourced local material. The page set is the smallest set that (a) owns one intent per page, (b) fills the gaps the competitor research found, and (c) can be written without a single invented fact.

**Count: 25 pages built (24 indexable + 404).** Static HTML generated by a Python build, same pattern as `sites/phils-auto-fleet-repair/build.py` (data dict per page, shared header/footer/schema functions, sitemap and lint at the end), with the improvements listed in section 7.

## 2. Deliberately NOT built, and why

| Not built | Reason | Reopen when |
|---|---|---|
| Citrus Heights city page | Evidence is one 2019 city flyer plus an undated hail article (BP-C13, BP-H03); cannot reach ~300 non-swappable words without invention. Listed on `/service-area/` | Owner supplies real jobs there, or a verified local fact set |
| City pages for Rancho Cordova, West Sacramento, Davis, Carmichael, Granite Bay, El Dorado Hills, Lincoln, Rocklin, Natomas | One or two facts each, several stale or unsourced. Doorway-page risk (rule 5) | Owner job proof per place; then at most one page per place |
| Service x city pages | Doorway pages by definition | Never |
| Spanish mirror | A mirror promises Spanish calls and texts the business may not offer. Demand exists (about 13% of county speaks Spanish at home) but capacity is unknown. No machine translation | Owner confirms Spanish-speaking capacity; then real translation with `hreflang` |
| Reviews page and review widgets | No reviews exist; "no reviews yet" pages weaken trust and invite fake-looking fillers (FTC rule) | First real Google reviews exist and the review link is supplied; then a short page that links out with attribution (no `AggregateRating`) |
| Gallery / before-after page | No real job photos. The hero is an illustration and is labelled as such | Owner shoots `PHOTO-SHOTLIST.md` priorities 1-5 and consents |
| Pricing / memberships / booking / deposit pages | No prices supplied; SB 478; booking engine belongs to the app project | Owner supplies prices and policy |
| Headlight restoration page | Not one of the owner's six named services; unconfirmed | Owner lists it as a service |
| Paint Deep-Clean as its own page | Query is Low; thin content risk; section on `/mobile-detailing/` instead | Owner sells it separately and supplies process facts |
| Door ding page | Folds into `/paintless-dent-repair/` to avoid cannibalization | Search Console shows distinct demand |
| Blog (10 posts) | No sourced local topics; four guides already cover the question set the research could support | Search Console query data |
| Ceramic coating vs wax / vs PPF guides | National, High-competition queries; PPF not offered or confirmed; no 916 product facts | Owner confirms products |
| Washing-at-home / stormwater guide | Ordinance text not retrieved; DIY audience, not buyers | Owner confirms water method and text is verified |
| Tesla/EV guide | Capability unconfirmed | Owner confirms aluminum/EV capability |
| Careers, team, locations, emergency, menu, financing | Not a fit for this business | n/a |
| Separate fleets and dealers pages | Same offer, one page is stronger | Distinct fleet volume content exists |
| Thank-you page | Form is inline with a success state; avoids a thin indexable page | A conversion tool needs a URL |

## 3. URL scheme

- Short, lowercase, hyphenated, trailing slash, no dates, no IDs: `/paintless-dent-repair/`.
- Service URLs carry the **real term**, not the brand label (`/ceramic-coating/`, not `/gloss-shield/`); the plain-language name is the visible label and appears in H2/H1 support copy.
- Guides under `/guides/`; places under `/service-area/<city>/`; everything else at the root.
- One canonical per page, absolute, final-domain placeholder `{{DOMAIN}}` stamped by script.
- `_redirects`: `/photo-estimate/`, `/estimate/`, `/quote/`, `/get-a-price/` to `/photo-quote/`; `/services/` to `/` (home carries the services grid; no thin `/services/` index); `/dealers/`, `/fleets/` to `/dealers-and-fleets/`; `/areas/` to `/service-area/`; `/pdr/`, `/dent-repair/`, `/dent-removal/` to `/paintless-dent-repair/`; `/hail/`, `/hail-fix/` to `/hail-damage-repair/`; `/detailing/`, `/auto-detailing/` to `/mobile-detailing/`; `/gloss-shield/` to `/ceramic-coating/`; `/swirl-scratch-erase/` to `/paint-correction/`; `/interior-reset/` to `/interior-detailing/`; `/pricing/`, `/prices/` to `/guides/what-affects-dent-repair-price/`; `/reviews/` to `/` until reviews exist (so a printed or posted `/reviews/` link never 404s).
- The existing Next.js app uses different URLs (`/services/<slug>`, `/areas/<city>`); this site is separate, but the redirect list above absorbs likely inbound guesses.

## 4. Navigation

- **Header (desktop):** logo (D-mark + live "916 DENT & DETAIL" text), Services (menu of six), Dealers & Fleets, Guides, Service area, Contact, and the gold button **Get a price from a photo**. Phone number visible as text with tap-to-call on mobile.
- **Header (390px):** logo, Call icon button, menu button. The primary action lives in the sticky bottom bar, not the header (see `CONVERSION-PLAN.md`).
- **Footer:** NAP block (name, phone, "Mobile service, no storefront", named cities), Instagram link, services, guides, legal links, accessibility contact line, "Leave a review" link only once the review URL exists.
- Owner-spec nav words "Pricing" and "Reviews" are not used (conflicts C6).

## 5. Breadcrumbs

Visible, `<nav aria-label="Breadcrumb">`, plus `BreadcrumbList` JSON-LD on every page except Home and 404.

| Page type | Trail |
|---|---|
| Service | Home > Paintless dent repair (label: the real term; the plain-language name sits in the H1 support copy) |
| Guide | Home > Guides > What affects dent repair price |
| City | Home > Service area > Elk Grove |
| Service area hub, About, Contact, FAQ, Photo quote, Dealers, Legal | Home > Page |

## 6. Internal-link rules

1. **Every page links to `/photo-quote/`** at least twice (once in the first screen's action row, once at the end), plus the sticky bar on mobile.
2. **Hub and spoke.** Home links to all six services, dealers, the four city pages (via the service-area hub), and the guides index. Each service page links back to Home, to its two nearest sibling services, to the one most relevant guide, and to `/service-area/`.
3. **Guides link to the matching service page and to `/photo-quote/`**, with descriptive anchors ("send a photo for a price"), never "click here".
4. **City pages link up** to `/service-area/`, to `/paintless-dent-repair/`, `/mobile-detailing/` and (Elk Grove, Roseville, Folsom, Sacramento) to `/dealers-and-fleets/` where a sourced auto-mall fact exists; they do not link sideways to other city pages except via the service-area hub (avoids a doorway mesh).
5. **Service-area hub** links to the four city pages and names the other ten places as plain text (no links, no pages).
6. **Dealers page** links to `/paintless-dent-repair/`, `/hail-damage-repair/`, `/photo-quote/`, `/contact/`, `/service-area/`.
7. **Keyword-bearing anchors, one target per anchor:** the anchor "paintless dent repair" always points to `/paintless-dent-repair/`; "ceramic coating" to `/ceramic-coating/`; "hail damage repair" to `/hail-damage-repair/`; "mobile detailing" to `/mobile-detailing/`. No page links to another page with the other page's primary keyword as an anchor unless that is the target.
8. **No orphan pages:** the build fails if any page has zero inbound links, or any internal link 404s.
9. **Footer repeats** a fixed set (services, guides, legal) so link equity is consistent; the sitemap lists the same URLs.
10. **No link to Instagram or any external site from body copy** except sources cited on a guide (with `rel="noopener"`); external links open in the same tab.

## 7. Engineering notes (mechanics only; design and copy are not borrowed)

Reuse from `sites/phils-auto-fleet-repair/build.py`: data-driven page dicts, a single `render()` with title/description/canonical/OG/schema slots, shared `breadcrumb_schema`, `faq_schema`, header/footer builders, sitemap, `_headers` and `_redirects` emission, `404.html`. `sites/quantum-growth/` does not exist in this repo, so the placeholder-stamping and leak-lint pieces are written new:

- **Tokens** (each one unmistakable, one per concern): `{{DOMAIN}}`, `{{FORM_ENDPOINT}}`, `{{ANALYTICS_ID}}`, `{{REVIEW_URL}}`, `{{INDEXNOW_KEY}}`, plus flag `PHONE_CONFIRMED`. `stamp.py` replaces them; `lint.py --production` fails while any token, `[CONFIRM`, TODO, lorem, replace-with, example.com or any COMPLIANCE.md section 15 string remains.
- **Content integrity:** per-page word-count and 5-word-shingle similarity gate (fail above 35% overlap between any two pages), the same defence the existing app uses.
- **Source ledger:** every city-page fact is a build-time field with `source_id` from `research/sources.csv`; a page with an unsourced fact fails the build, and a city page under ~300 unique words is dropped from the build (and from the sitemap) rather than padded.
- **Fonts:** self-hosted woff2 from `916-dent-detail/src/fonts/` (Michroma 400, Inter 400/600, Basic Latin + Latin-1 subset, OFL licence files included), copied into `public/assets/fonts/`.
- **Images:** the build copies only the optimized hero frames it needs (see DESIGN-BRIEF performance plan), logo and favicon derivatives from `916-dent-detail/public/brand/`, and generates per-page OG cards from templates.
